description: Institutions remain fragmented and respond after risks escalate into crisis.
Emerging risks are framed through threat control surveillance and emergency authority.
Powerful actors shape future narratives to protect rents and delay accountability.
Reports and workshops proliferate while budgets regulation and implementation remain unchanged.
Expert led future analysis expands but public contestability and justice safeguards remain weak.
Institutions connect foresight early warning participation and adaptive authority to public delivery.
Communities officials researchers and civic institutions co create future oriented policy capacity.
